about: Published quarterly total returns of mutual funds (percent; [Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4] per calendar year; null = not published), used by backtester/fund_history.py to repair the quarters where the free (Yahoo) daily history misses or misstates distributions. Morningstar's figures: NAV-based, distributions reinvested, net of expenses, before sales loads. Each entry names its source and retrieval date. Entries collected by hand cover the years where the free data is known to be unreliable (from the start of the fund's price file to 2000 at least); the data job (scripts/fetch_data.py fetch_fund_returns) adds entries for funds with a pre-2000 history that have none, from Yahoo's quoteSummary fundPerformance module (the same figures; entries already here are never replaced).
